bank.keyText: She shared the 1962 Nobel Prize with Wilkins.
choiceTexts: She trained as a physical chemist at Cambridge.
She spent three years in Paris learning X-ray methods.
She moved to Birkbeck College and worked on viruses.
She died in 1958 at the age of thirty-seven.
She shared the 1962 Nobel Prize with Wilkins.

answer.text: She shared the 1962 Nobel Prize with Wilkins.
answer.line: Paragraph 10 says the 1962 prize went to Watson, Crick and Wilkins. Franklin had died in 1958.

steps: Flip the job. Four choices are in the passage; you are hunting the one that is not.

The one left standing is the prize. Sentence 6 gives it to Watson, Crick and Wilkins.
